name: HZ_ORIG_SYS_REFERENCES
description: The HZ_ORIG_SYSTEM_REFERENCES table stores the mapping between source system references and the owner tables. The source system reference is an identifier for the record that the data came from the source system and the owner table is the TCA table, which stores that data. A record with an Active status means the cross-reference mapping between TCA and source system is vaild.  An Inactive status means the cross-referencing mapping is no longer valid.

columns.name: ORIG_SYSTEM_REF_ID
columns.description: Sequentially generated identifier

columns.name: ORIG_SYSTEM
columns.description: Source system name

columns.name: ORIG_SYSTEM_REFERENCE
columns.description: Source system id for the source system logical entit

columns.name: OWNER_TABLE_NAME
columns.description: TCA tables that have source system reference column

columns.name: OWNER_TABLE_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier for a record in the owner table

columns.name: STATUS
columns.description: A for Active. Mapping is validI for Inactive. Mapping is invalidThe default is A for Active.

columns.name: REASON_CODE
columns.description: Reason for setting the record to Inactive

columns.name: OLD_ORIG_SYSTEM_REFERENCE
columns.description: Old source system reference that is being replaced

columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.
